title: Rick Steves Iceland
speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】裡克史蒂夫斯 冰島（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hi. I'm Rick Steves on the wild and western fringe of Europe.
cues.en: Hi. I'm Rick Steves on the wild and western fringe of Europe.
cues.zh: 你好。我是裡克史蒂夫斯，生活在歐洲西部荒野邊緣。

cues.text: It's Iceland--the land of thunderous waterfalls, fiery volcanoes, and the midnight sun.
cues.en: It's Iceland--the land of thunderous waterfalls, fiery volcanoes, and the midnight sun.
cues.zh: 這就是冰島——這片土地上有雷鳴般的瀑布、熾熱的火山和午夜的太陽。

cues.text: With a resilient culture and epic natural thrills, we'll see why this little island
cues.en: With a resilient culture and epic natural thrills, we'll see why this little island
cues.zh: 憑藉著富有活力的文化和史詩般的自然刺激，我們將瞭解為什麼這個小島

cues.text: is so dang popular.
cues.en: is so dang popular.
cues.zh: 太受歡迎了。

cues.text: Thanks for joining us!
cues.en: Thanks for joining us!
cues.zh: 感謝您加入我們！

cues.text: To fully experience Iceland, we start in the capital city,
cues.en: To fully experience Iceland, we start in the capital city,
cues.zh: 為了充分體驗冰島，我們從首都開始，

cues.text: Reykjavík, then we day-trip deep into the blustery interior
cues.en: Reykjavík, then we day-trip deep into the blustery interior
cues.zh: 雷克雅未克，然後我們深入狂風大作的內陸一日遊

cues.text: to sample the power of nature on the famed Golden Circle,
cues.en: to sample the power of nature on the famed Golden Circle,
cues.zh: 在著名的黃金圈體驗大自然的力量，

cues.text: and then we do the epic road trip: Iceland's 800-mile Ring Road
cues.en: and then we do the epic road trip: Iceland's 800-mile Ring Road
cues.zh: 然後我們開始史詩般的公路旅行：冰島 800 英里的環路

cues.text: circling this unforgettable island.
cues.en: circling this unforgettable island.
cues.zh: 環繞著這座令人難忘的島嶼。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Reykjavík, with its landmark church, ruddy urban charm,
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Reykjavík, with its landmark church, ruddy urban charm,
cues.zh: 瑞克（Rick），畫外音：雷克雅維克，有著地標的教堂，紅潤的都市魅力，

cues.text: and determined cultural life is our springboard.
cues.en: and determined cultural life is our springboard.
cues.zh: 而堅定的文化生活就是我們的跳板。

cues.text: After soaking with the locals in a thermal pool and enjoying an Icelandic feast,
cues.en: After soaking with the locals in a thermal pool and enjoying an Icelandic feast,
cues.zh: 與當地人一起泡溫泉、享用冰島大餐後，

cues.text: we do the famous Golden Circle day trip.
cues.en: we do the famous Golden Circle day trip.
cues.zh: 我們進行著名的黃金圈一日遊。

cues.text: We'll see the gorge where Europe meets America,
cues.en: We'll see the gorge where Europe meets America,
cues.zh: 我們會看到歐洲與美洲交會處的峽谷，

cues.text: thrill under the original "geyser," and feel the spray of a thundering waterfall.
cues.en: thrill under the original "geyser," and feel the spray of a thundering waterfall.
cues.zh: 在原始的「間歇泉」下驚險刺激，感受雷鳴般的瀑布噴射出的水花。

cues.text: Then we hit the road-- the Ring Road-- and circle the entire island.
cues.en: Then we hit the road-- the Ring Road-- and circle the entire island.
cues.zh: 然後我們上路——環路——並環繞整個島嶼。

cues.text: With help from Cameron Hewitt, my friend and fellow guidebook author, we'll do it all:
cues.en: With help from Cameron Hewitt, my friend and fellow guidebook author, we'll do it all:
cues.zh: 在我的朋友兼旅遊指南作者卡梅倫·休伊特 (Cameron Hewitt) 的幫助下，我們將完成這一切：

cues.text: exploring waterfalls, hiking through steaming geothermal fields, cruising lagoons bobbing with icebergs,
cues.en: exploring waterfalls, hiking through steaming geothermal fields, cruising lagoons bobbing with icebergs,
cues.zh: 探索瀑布，徒步穿越熱氣騰騰的地熱田，巡遊冰山起伏的潟湖，

cues.text: fording glacial rivers, gathering eggs local style...
cues.en: fording glacial rivers, gathering eggs local style...
cues.zh: 涉水冰川河流，採集當地風格的雞蛋...

cues.text: and wandering evocative black-sand beaches.
cues.en: and wandering evocative black-sand beaches.
cues.zh: 以及漫步令人回味的黑沙灘。

cues.text: We'll chase rainbows, elusive whales, roaming horses, and the cutest puffins.
cues.en: We'll chase rainbows, elusive whales, roaming horses, and the cutest puffins.
cues.zh: 我們將追逐彩虹、難以捉摸的鯨魚、漫遊的馬匹和最可愛的海雀。

cues.text: Iceland, about the size of Virginia with just 400,000 people, sits between Greenland and Norway.
cues.en: Iceland, about the size of Virginia with just 400,000 people, sits between Greenland and Norway.
cues.zh: 冰島面積與維吉尼亞州相當，人口只有 40 萬，位於格陵蘭和挪威之間。

cues.text: From Reykjavík, after the Golden Circle day trip, we hit the Ring Road.
cues.en: From Reykjavík, after the Golden Circle day trip, we hit the Ring Road.
cues.zh: 從雷克雅未克出發，結束了黃金圈一日遊，我們踏上環城公路。

cues.text: We explore the South Coast, side-tripping up Thorsmork valley
cues.en: We explore the South Coast, side-tripping up Thorsmork valley
cues.zh: 我們探索南海岸，順便爬上索斯莫克山谷

cues.text: and sailing to the Westman Islands.
cues.en: and sailing to the Westman Islands.
cues.zh: 並航行至韋斯特曼群島。

cues.text: After Vík, we see glacial lagoons, the rugged Eastfjords,
cues.en: After Vík, we see glacial lagoons, the rugged Eastfjords,
cues.zh: 維克之後，我們看到冰河潟湖、崎嶇的東峽灣、

cues.text: geothermal hot zones around Lake Myvatn, the fishing village of Húsavík in the far north,
cues.en: geothermal hot zones around Lake Myvatn, the fishing village of Húsavík in the far north,
cues.zh: 米湖周圍的地熱熱點地區，遠北的胡薩維克漁村，

cues.text: and Snaefellsnes Peninsula before finishing back where we started.
cues.en: and Snaefellsnes Peninsula before finishing back where we started.
cues.zh: 和斯奈山半島，然後回到我們出發的地方。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík, by far the biggest city in the country,
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík, by far the biggest city in the country,
cues.zh: ♪ 雷克雅未克，迄今為止全國最大的城市，

cues.text: is still small--it's about the size of Berkeley, or Fargo.
cues.en: is still small--it's about the size of Berkeley, or Fargo.
cues.zh: 仍然很小——大約有伯克利或法戈那麼大。

cues.text: With a hard-scrabble heritage and a vibrant culture, today it offers a tourist- friendly mix of old and new.
cues.en: With a hard-scrabble heritage and a vibrant culture, today it offers a tourist- friendly mix of old and new.
cues.zh: 憑藉艱苦奮鬥的遺產和充滿活力的文化，今天它提供了新舊融合的旅遊友好型。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: While short on world-class sights, Reykjavík certainly has an urban vitality,
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: While short on world-class sights, Reykjavík certainly has an urban vitality,
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：雖然雷克雅維克缺乏世界一流的景點，但它確實擁有城市活力，

cues.text: with plenty of restaurants and shopping to keep visitors entertained.
cues.en: with plenty of restaurants and shopping to keep visitors entertained.
cues.zh: 有大量的餐廳和購物場所供遊客娛樂。

cues.text: It's unexpectedly cosmopolitan, with an artistic, bohemian flair.
cues.en: It's unexpectedly cosmopolitan, with an artistic, bohemian flair.
cues.zh: 它出乎意料地具有國際化氣息，具有藝術氣息和波西米亞風格。

cues.text: And it's blustery.
cues.en: And it's blustery.
cues.zh: 而且風很大。

cues.text: Iceland can be cold even in summer.
cues.en: Iceland can be cold even in summer.
cues.zh: 冰島即使在夏天也會很冷。

cues.text: This is a typical day in July...and so is this.
cues.en: This is a typical day in July...and so is this.
cues.zh: 這是七月中典型的一天……這也是。

cues.text: If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes.
cues.en: If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes.
cues.zh: 如果您不喜歡現在的天氣，請等待幾分鐘。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík's neighborhoods are enlivened by street art.
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík's neighborhoods are enlivened by street art.
cues.zh: ♪ 街頭藝術讓雷克雅未克的街區充滿活力。

cues.text: A blank wall will just get tagged with graffiti anyway, so, instead, homeowners hire talented street artists
cues.en: A blank wall will just get tagged with graffiti anyway, so, instead, homeowners hire talented street artists
cues.zh: 無論如何，空白的牆壁都會被塗鴉標記，因此，房主會聘請才華橫溢的街頭藝術家

cues.text: to create colorful murals.
cues.en: to create colorful murals.
cues.zh: 創作色彩繽紛的壁畫。

cues.text: ♪ It seems every street leads to Hallgríms Church,
cues.en: ♪ It seems every street leads to Hallgríms Church,
cues.zh: ♪ 似乎每條街道都通往哈爾格林姆斯教堂，

cues.text: crowning a hill in the town center.
cues.en: crowning a hill in the town center.
cues.zh: 位於鎮中心的一座小山上。

cues.text: Designed by Iceland's state architect in the 1930s, the church represents the national style.
cues.en: Designed by Iceland's state architect in the 1930s, the church represents the national style.
cues.zh: 教堂由冰島國家建築師於1930年代設計，代表了民族風格。

cues.text: Stark and utilitarian, yet beautiful, it evokes the island's volcanic landscape.
cues.en: Stark and utilitarian, yet beautiful, it evokes the island's volcanic landscape.
cues.zh: 它樸素而實用，但又美麗，讓人想起島上的火山景觀。

cues.text: Stairstepped gables echo Iceland's basalt cliffs.
cues.en: Stairstepped gables echo Iceland's basalt cliffs.
cues.zh: 階梯式山牆與冰島的玄武岩懸崖遙相呼應。

cues.text: ♪ The interior is Lutheran-- serene and austere.
cues.en: ♪ The interior is Lutheran-- serene and austere.
cues.zh: ♪ 內部是路德會風格－寧靜而樸實。

cues.text: The glass is clear, not stained...
cues.en: The glass is clear, not stained...
cues.zh: 玻璃是透明的，沒有染色...

cues.text: and the altar is a simple table.
cues.en: and the altar is a simple table.
cues.zh: 祭壇是一張簡單的桌子。

cues.text: ♪ An elevator whisks visitors to the top of the tower
cues.en: ♪ An elevator whisks visitors to the top of the tower
cues.zh: ♪ 電梯將遊客帶到塔頂

cues.text: for panoramic views over all of Reykjavík.
cues.en: for panoramic views over all of Reykjavík.
cues.zh: 欣賞整個雷克雅未克的全景。

cues.text: ♪ Two out of every 3 Icelanders lives within sight of this steeple.
cues.en: ♪ Two out of every 3 Icelanders lives within sight of this steeple.
cues.zh: ♪ 每 3 個冰島人中就有 2 個住在這座尖塔的視野範圍內。

cues.text: ♪ In front of the church stands a statue of Leif Erikson.
cues.en: ♪ In front of the church stands a statue of Leif Erikson.
cues.zh: ♪ 教堂前矗立著雷夫‧艾瑞克森的雕像。

cues.text: Born here in Iceland, this Viking explorer is believed to be the first European to set foot
cues.en: Born here in Iceland, this Viking explorer is believed to be the first European to set foot
cues.zh: 這位出生於冰島的維京探險家被認為是第一個踏足冰島的歐洲人

cues.text: in the Americas-- about 5 centuries before Christopher Columbus.
cues.en: in the Americas-- about 5 centuries before Christopher Columbus.
cues.zh: 在美洲——大約比克里斯多福哥倫布早 5 個世紀。

cues.text: ♪ The modern sculpture called "The Sea Voyager"
cues.en: ♪ The modern sculpture called "The Sea Voyager"
cues.zh: ♪ 現代雕塑“航海家號”

cues.text: is an homage to those Scandinavian adventurers who, beginning in the ninth century,
cues.en: is an homage to those Scandinavian adventurers who, beginning in the ninth century,
cues.zh: 是對那些從九世紀開始的斯堪的納維亞冒險家的敬意，

cues.text: loaded up their ships, set sail into an uncharted ocean,
cues.en: loaded up their ships, set sail into an uncharted ocean,
cues.zh: 裝滿船隻，揚帆駛向未知的海洋，

cues.text: and brought civilization to this uninhabited island.
cues.en: and brought civilization to this uninhabited island.
cues.zh: 並為這個無人島帶來了文明。

cues.text: ♪ Iceland, so harsh and desolate, steaming with volcanoes, was settled
cues.en: ♪ Iceland, so harsh and desolate, steaming with volcanoes, was settled
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島，如此嚴酷荒涼，火山爆發，已定居

cues.text: over 1,000 years ago by early Norse farmers.
cues.en: over 1,000 years ago by early Norse farmers.
cues.zh: 1000 多年前，由早期挪威農民發明。

cues.text: ♪ Imagine the original Icelanders-- hardy folk eking out a living on remote farms,
cues.en: ♪ Imagine the original Icelanders-- hardy folk eking out a living on remote farms,
cues.zh: ♪ 想像一下最初的冰島人——在偏遠農場勉強維持生計的頑強人民，

cues.text: living in isolation.
cues.en: living in isolation.
cues.zh: 生活在孤立之中。

cues.text: They chronicled their lives in "the Sagas"-- a blending of historical records,
cues.en: They chronicled their lives in "the Sagas"-- a blending of historical records,
cues.zh: 他們在「傳奇」中記錄了自己的生活——混合了歷史記錄，

cues.text: tall tales, and legends.
cues.en: tall tales, and legends.
cues.zh: 荒誕的故事和傳說。

cues.text: ♪ From the age of the Vikings, the country grew slowly.
cues.en: ♪ From the age of the Vikings, the country grew slowly.
cues.zh: ♪ 從維京人時代開始，這個國家就緩慢發展。

cues.text: By the mid-1700s, all of Iceland still only had about 50,000 people, and Reykjavík was just a big farm.
cues.en: By the mid-1700s, all of Iceland still only had about 50,000 people, and Reykjavík was just a big farm.
cues.zh: 到1700年代中期，整個冰島仍然只有大約5萬人口，雷克雅維克只是一個大農場。

cues.text: As trade, mostly fishing, increased, and towns began to form,
cues.en: As trade, mostly fishing, increased, and towns began to form,
cues.zh: 隨著貿易（主要是漁業）的增加，城鎮開始形成，

cues.text: Reykjavík emerged as the capital city.
cues.en: Reykjavík emerged as the capital city.
cues.zh: 雷克雅未克成為首都。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: The National Museum collects artifacts from these early days of Iceland.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: The National Museum collects artifacts from these early days of Iceland.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：國立博物館收藏冰島早期的文物。

cues.text: A society made of wood doesn't leave much behind.
cues.en: A society made of wood doesn't leave much behind.
cues.zh: 一個由木頭組成的社會不會留下太多東西。

cues.text: ♪ But a few exquisite items, like these ornamental horns,
cues.en: ♪ But a few exquisite items, like these ornamental horns,
cues.zh: ♪ 但有一些精緻的物品，像是這些裝飾性的角，

cues.text: and these whalebone carvings, survive.
cues.en: and these whalebone carvings, survive.
cues.zh: 這些鯨骨雕刻品得以存活。

cues.text: ♪ Pagan Iceland converted to Christianity
cues.en: ♪ Pagan Iceland converted to Christianity
cues.zh: ♪ 異教冰島皈依基督教

cues.text: in about the year 1000.
cues.en: in about the year 1000.
cues.zh: 大約在1000年。

cues.text: Until relatively modern times, Icelandic settlers lived in rustic cottages.
cues.en: Until relatively modern times, Icelandic settlers lived in rustic cottages.
cues.zh: 直到近代，冰島定居者都住在鄉村小屋裡。

cues.text: Existence may have been bleak, but families were tight-knit.
cues.en: Existence may have been bleak, but families were tight-knit.
cues.zh: 生活可能很黯淡，但家庭卻很緊密。

cues.text: Many Icelanders lived simple lives, much like this,
cues.en: Many Icelanders lived simple lives, much like this,
cues.zh: 許多冰島人過著簡單的生活，就像這樣，

cues.text: until the early 20th century.
cues.en: until the early 20th century.
cues.zh: 直到20世紀初。

cues.text: ♪ Life was tied to the sea.
cues.en: ♪ Life was tied to the sea.
cues.zh: ♪ 生命與大海息息相關。

cues.text: Icelanders sailed in open boats, fished for cod,
cues.en: Icelanders sailed in open boats, fished for cod,
cues.zh: 冰島人開著敞篷船航行，捕捉鱈魚，

cues.text: and hunted shark for their valuable liver oil.
cues.en: and hunted shark for their valuable liver oil.
cues.zh: 並捕獵鯊魚以獲取寶貴的肝油。

cues.text: ♪ More and more, symbols like an official national costume
cues.en: ♪ More and more, symbols like an official national costume
cues.zh: ♪ 越來越多的符號像官方民族服裝

cues.text: and its own flag demonstrated a growing sense of national identity.
cues.en: and its own flag demonstrated a growing sense of national identity.
cues.zh: 其國旗也顯示出日益增長的民族認同感。

cues.text: Iceland remained part of Denmark through the 1800s.
cues.en: Iceland remained part of Denmark through the 1800s.
cues.zh: 在整個 1800 年代，冰島一直是丹麥的一部分。

cues.text: Iceland-born politician Jón Sigurdsson lobbied in Copenhagen for independence,
cues.en: Iceland-born politician Jón Sigurdsson lobbied in Copenhagen for independence,
cues.zh: 冰島出生的政治家喬恩·西於爾松 (Jón Sigurdsson) 在哥本哈根遊說獨立，

cues.text: which Denmark finally granted in 1918.
cues.en: which Denmark finally granted in 1918.
cues.zh: 丹麥最終於 1918 年批准。

cues.text: ♪ Iceland's parliament, called the Althing, may seem humble.
cues.en: ♪ Iceland's parliament, called the Althing, may seem humble.
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島議會，稱為 Althing，可能看起來很謙虛。

cues.text: But it represents a thousand- year journey in this society from rustic farmsteads to today's
cues.en: But it represents a thousand- year journey in this society from rustic farmsteads to today's
cues.zh: 但它代表了這個社會從鄉村農莊到今天的一千年的歷程。

cues.text: modern, democratic nation.
cues.en: modern, democratic nation.
cues.zh: 現代、民主國家。

cues.text: ♪ Rick, voice-over: For locals, Parliament Square remains a place to make your voice heard...
cues.en: ♪ Rick, voice-over: For locals, Parliament Square remains a place to make your voice heard...
cues.zh: ♪ 裡克，畫外音：對當地人來說，議會廣場仍然是一個讓人們聽到你的聲音的地方...

cues.text: or to just hang out.
cues.en: or to just hang out.
cues.zh: 或者只是閒逛。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík still has a hardworking harbor,
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík still has a hardworking harbor,
cues.zh: ♪ 雷克雅未克仍有一個勤奮的港口，

cues.text: busy with both industrial vessels and sightseeing boats.
cues.en: busy with both industrial vessels and sightseeing boats.
cues.zh: 繁忙的工業船隻和觀光船。

cues.text: And, in just the last generation, boldly modern condos and office towers show how today's Iceland
cues.en: And, in just the last generation, boldly modern condos and office towers show how today's Iceland
cues.zh: 而且，在上一代中，大膽的現代公寓和辦公大樓展示了今天的冰島

cues.text: is charging into the future.
cues.en: is charging into the future.
cues.zh: 正在衝向未來。

cues.text: ♪ And a fine example of that is the super-modern concert hall,
cues.en: ♪ And a fine example of that is the super-modern concert hall,
cues.zh: ♪ 超現代的音樂廳就是一個很好的例子，

cues.text: called Harpa.
cues.en: called Harpa.
cues.zh: 叫哈帕。

cues.text: ♪ In the lobby, the sky reflects like you're inside
cues.en: ♪ In the lobby, the sky reflects like you're inside
cues.zh: ♪ 在大廳裡，天空的倒影就像你在裡面一樣

cues.text: a giant honeycombed prism.
cues.en: a giant honeycombed prism.
cues.zh: 一個巨大的蜂窩稜鏡。

cues.text: ♪ This extravagant use of space and glass
cues.en: ♪ This extravagant use of space and glass
cues.zh: ♪ 對空間和玻璃的過度利用

cues.text: put Iceland on the world's architectural map when it opened in 2011.
cues.en: put Iceland on the world's architectural map when it opened in 2011.
cues.zh: 2011 年開幕時，冰島已躋身世界建築版圖。

cues.en: Dark, chunky lava rock blanketed by cushy moss covers much of Iceland's surface, giving the countryside
cues.zh: 冰島大部分地表覆蓋著黑色厚實的熔岩，上面覆蓋著柔軟的苔蘚，呈現出鄉村的氣息

cues.text: a desolate, almost lunar feel.
cues.en: a desolate, almost lunar feel.
cues.zh: 一種荒涼的、近乎月球般的感覺。

cues.text: ♪ And the Icelanders have ingeniously harnessed their endless supply of green energy.
cues.en: ♪ And the Icelanders have ingeniously harnessed their endless supply of green energy.
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島人巧妙地利用了源源不絕的綠色能源。

cues.text: Geothermal plants, in the middle of nowhere, are hard at work, boring deep into the earth's crust
cues.en: Geothermal plants, in the middle of nowhere, are hard at work, boring deep into the earth's crust
cues.zh: 地熱發電廠在偏僻的地方正在努力工作，深入地殼

cues.text: to tap into hot water.
cues.en: to tap into hot water.
cues.zh: 接入熱水。

cues.text: And pipelines carry that super-heated water through miles of countryside to heat and power
cues.en: And pipelines carry that super-heated water through miles of countryside to heat and power
cues.zh: 管道將過熱水輸送到綿延數英里的鄉村，用於供熱和發電

cues.text: Reykjavík and other communities.
cues.en: Reykjavík and other communities.
cues.zh: 雷克雅未克和其他社群。

cues.text: ♪ Despite the chill, houses are toasty.
cues.en: ♪ Despite the chill, houses are toasty.
cues.zh: ♪ 儘管寒冷，房子裡卻很溫暖。

cues.text: In fact, you'll notice many small windows propped open.
cues.en: In fact, you'll notice many small windows propped open.
cues.zh: 事實上，您會注意到許多小窗戶是開啟的。

cues.text: Because that geothermal heat is so cheap, people don't even bother turning down the radiator.
cues.en: Because that geothermal heat is so cheap, people don't even bother turning down the radiator.
cues.zh: 由於地熱非常便宜，人們甚至懶得關掉散熱器。

cues.text: They just crack the window.
cues.en: They just crack the window.
cues.zh: 他們只是把窗戶打碎。

cues.text: ♪ The most enjoyable use for Iceland's hot water
cues.en: ♪ The most enjoyable use for Iceland's hot water
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島熱水最享受的使用方式

cues.text: is its thermal pools.
cues.en: is its thermal pools.
cues.zh: 是它的溫泉池。

cues.text: And the most famous spa is 45 minutes outside Reykjavík:
cues.en: And the most famous spa is 45 minutes outside Reykjavík:
cues.zh: 最著名的水療中心距離雷克雅維克 45 分鐘車程：

cues.text: The Blue Lagoon.
cues.en: The Blue Lagoon.
cues.zh: 藍色潟湖。

cues.text: Years ago, a geothermal plant began dumping its hot, mineral-rich waste water into this lava landscape.
cues.en: Years ago, a geothermal plant began dumping its hot, mineral-rich waste water into this lava landscape.
cues.zh: 幾年前，一家地熱發電廠開始將富含礦物質的高溫廢水倒入這片熔岩景觀中。

cues.text: Locals discovered it was a great place to take a dip.
cues.en: Locals discovered it was a great place to take a dip.
cues.zh: 當地人發現這是一個游泳的好地方。

cues.text: Developers then transformed it into a high-end spa.
cues.en: Developers then transformed it into a high-end spa.
cues.zh: 開發商隨後將其改造成高階水療中心。

cues.text: Today, Iceland's top tourist attraction is close to the airport
cues.en: Today, Iceland's top tourist attraction is close to the airport
cues.zh: 今天，冰島頂級旅遊景點就在機場附近

cues.text: and a popular first or last stop for visitors.
cues.en: and a popular first or last stop for visitors.
cues.zh: 也是遊客喜愛的第一站或最後一站。

cues.text: The Blue Lagoon is a lavish spa, but it's extremely touristy
cues.en: The Blue Lagoon is a lavish spa, but it's extremely touristy
cues.zh: 藍色潟湖是一個豪華的水療中心，但它非常適合旅遊

cues.text: and you sure won't meet many Icelanders here.
cues.en: and you sure won't meet many Icelanders here.
cues.zh: 你肯定不會在這裡遇到很多冰島人。

cues.text: But the good news: you have plenty of alternatives that are just as relaxing-- the community thermal pools.
cues.en: But the good news: you have plenty of alternatives that are just as relaxing-- the community thermal pools.
cues.zh: 但好訊息是：您還有很多同樣令人放鬆的選擇—社群溫泉池。

cues.text: ♪ The Blue Lagoon is popular.
cues.en: ♪ The Blue Lagoon is popular.
cues.zh: ♪ 藍色潟湖很受歡迎。

cues.text: But it's expensive--- about 10 times the cost of a pool like this.
cues.en: But it's expensive--- about 10 times the cost of a pool like this.
cues.zh: 但它很貴——大約是這樣一個游泳池的成本的 10 倍。

cues.text: You can luxuriate in the Blue Lagoon or you can soak with the locals in a neighborhood pool.
cues.en: You can luxuriate in the Blue Lagoon or you can soak with the locals in a neighborhood pool.
cues.zh: 您可以在藍色潟湖盡情享受，也可以與當地人一起在附近的游泳池裡泡澡。

cues.text: The choice is yours. Today, I'm soakin' local.
cues.en: The choice is yours. Today, I'm soakin' local.
cues.zh: 選擇權在你。今天，我沉浸在當地。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Fed by natural thermal springs, the main pool is bathwater-warm.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Fed by natural thermal springs, the main pool is bathwater-warm.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：主池由天然溫泉注入，水溫如洗澡水般溫暖。

cues.text: Waterslides, cascades, and kids' zones keep locals entertained.
cues.en: Waterslides, cascades, and kids' zones keep locals entertained.
cues.zh: 滑水道、瀑布和兒童區為當地人帶來無窮樂趣。

cues.text: This is where Icelanders meet up after work to connect with friends and family.
cues.en: This is where Icelanders meet up after work to connect with friends and family.
cues.zh: 這是冰島人下班後與朋友和家人聚會的地方。

cues.text: I can't think of a better way to meet the locals.
cues.en: I can't think of a better way to meet the locals.
cues.zh: 我想不出更好的方式來認識當地人。

cues.text: And for the ultimate in relaxation, hundred-degree hot pots simmer nearby.
cues.en: And for the ultimate in relaxation, hundred-degree hot pots simmer nearby.
cues.zh: 為了獲得極致的放鬆，附近有一個一百度的火鍋。

cues.text: Soaking together is a great equalizer.
cues.en: Soaking together is a great equalizer.
cues.zh: 一起浸泡是一個很好的均衡器。

cues.text: Student, truck driver, doctor, and tourist-- everybody's equal in the pool.
cues.en: Student, truck driver, doctor, and tourist-- everybody's equal in the pool.
cues.zh: 學生、卡車司機、醫生和遊客——泳池裡每個人都是平等的。

cues.text: Iceland is all about the great outdoors.
cues.en: Iceland is all about the great outdoors.
cues.zh: 冰島充滿了戶外活動。

cues.text: But if the weather's bad, as it often is, several indoor sights here in Reykjavík
cues.en: But if the weather's bad, as it often is, several indoor sights here in Reykjavík
cues.zh: 但如果天氣不好（通常），雷克雅未克的幾個室內景點

cues.text: offer a taste of the majesty of Iceland without leaving the capital city.
cues.en: offer a taste of the majesty of Iceland without leaving the capital city.
cues.zh: 足不出戶即可領略冰島的雄偉壯麗。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: At the edge of town is a one-stop way to experience this country's top natural wonders,
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: At the edge of town is a one-stop way to experience this country's top natural wonders,
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：在城鎮邊緣是體驗這個國家頂級自然奇觀的一站式方式，

cues.text: at least virtually, under one roof--The Pearl.
cues.en: at least virtually, under one roof--The Pearl.
cues.zh: 至少實際上，在同一個屋簷下──珍珠號。

cues.text: Exhibits feature fiery volcanoes, with majestic footage that gives a sense of awe,
cues.en: Exhibits feature fiery volcanoes, with majestic footage that gives a sense of awe,
cues.zh: 展品以熾熱的火山為特色，雄偉的鏡頭給人一種敬畏的感覺，

cues.text: birds perched precariously on towering cliffs, and a 300-foot-long ice cave.
cues.en: birds perched precariously on towering cliffs, and a 300-foot-long ice cave.
cues.zh: 鳥兒危險地棲息在高聳的懸崖和 300 英尺長的冰洞上。

cues.text: It's a primer on Icelandic nature, especially worthwhile for those without the time or money
cues.en: It's a primer on Icelandic nature, especially worthwhile for those without the time or money
cues.zh: 這是冰島自然風光的入門讀物，對於那些沒有時間或金錢的人來說尤其值得

cues.text: to see the real thing.
cues.en: to see the real thing.
cues.zh: 看到真實的東西。

cues.text: The most elusive natural thrill is the Aurora Borealis.
cues.en: The most elusive natural thrill is the Aurora Borealis.
cues.zh: 最難以捉摸的自然刺激是北極光。

cues.text: In summer, when it's too light to see these Northern Lights, you can step into the planetarium
cues.en: In summer, when it's too light to see these Northern Lights, you can step into the planetarium
cues.zh: 夏天，當光線太亮而看不到北極光時，您可以走進天文館

cues.text: to get a sense of this fabled phenomenon.
cues.en: to get a sense of this fabled phenomenon.
cues.zh: 來瞭解這個傳說中的現象。

cues.text: But of course, there's nothing like experiencing the real thing.
cues.en: But of course, there's nothing like experiencing the real thing.
cues.zh: 當然，沒有什麼比體驗真實的事情更好的了。

cues.text: Remember, even if you come in the winter solely for the Northern Lights,
cues.en: Remember, even if you come in the winter solely for the Northern Lights,
cues.zh: 請記住，即使您冬天來只是為了看北極光，

cues.text: there's no guarantees of seeing them.
cues.en: there's no guarantees of seeing them.
cues.zh: 不能保證一定能見到他們。

cues.text: But if you do see those ethereal lights dancing in the sky, the experience
cues.en: But if you do see those ethereal lights dancing in the sky, the experience
cues.zh: 但如果你確實看到那些飄逸的燈光在天空中舞動，這種體驗

cues.text: will stay with you for the rest of your days.
cues.en: will stay with you for the rest of your days.
cues.zh: 將陪伴您度過餘生。

cues.text: ♪ The weather's great, and from Reykjavík,
cues.en: ♪ The weather's great, and from Reykjavík,
cues.zh: ♪ 天氣很好，從雷克雅維克出發，

cues.text: we're making the classic 150-mile day-trip loop: the Golden Circle.
cues.en: we're making the classic 150-mile day-trip loop: the Golden Circle.
cues.zh: 我們正在製作經典的 150 英里一日遊環線：黃金圈。

cues.text: Within minutes, we're immersed in Iceland's iconic wide-open spaces and enjoying the dramatic scenery
cues.en: Within minutes, we're immersed in Iceland's iconic wide-open spaces and enjoying the dramatic scenery
cues.zh: 幾分鐘之內，我們就沉浸在冰島標誌性的開闊空間中，欣賞壯麗的風景

cues.text: of this island's natural wonders.
cues.en: of this island's natural wonders.
cues.zh: 這座島嶼的自然奇觀。

cues.text: Today, we'll see gorges, waterfalls, geysers, and more, with epic views all along the way.
cues.en: Today, we'll see gorges, waterfalls, geysers, and more, with epic views all along the way.
cues.zh: 今天，我們將看到峽谷、瀑布、間歇泉等，沿途欣賞壯麗的景色。

cues.text: By the way, most people do this as a day-trip on a tour bus.
cues.en: By the way, most people do this as a day-trip on a tour bus.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，大多數人都是乘坐旅遊巴士進行一日遊。

cues.text: But we're driving.
cues.en: But we're driving.
cues.zh: 但我們正在開車。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Our first stop is Thingvellir.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Our first stop is Thingvellir.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：我們的第一站是辛格維利爾。

cues.text: This national park is important to Icelanders for two reasons.
cues.en: This national park is important to Icelanders for two reasons.
cues.zh: 這個國家公園對冰島人來說很重要，原因有二。

cues.text: First, at this gorge, you can see the rift that marks that slow separation of tectonic plates.
cues.en: First, at this gorge, you can see the rift that marks that slow separation of tectonic plates.
cues.zh: 首先，在這個峽谷，您可以看到標誌板塊緩慢分離的裂谷。

cues.text: Walking along this fissure in the earth's crust, travelers sense this meeting of two continents:
cues.en: Walking along this fissure in the earth's crust, travelers sense this meeting of two continents:
cues.zh: 沿著地殼的這條裂縫行走，旅人會感受到兩大洲的交會：

cues.text: America on the left, Europe on the right.
cues.en: America on the left, Europe on the right.
cues.zh: 左邊是美國，右邊是歐洲。

cues.text: And second, Thingvellir, which means "Assembly Plains," was the site of the original Althing,
cues.en: And second, Thingvellir, which means "Assembly Plains," was the site of the original Althing,
cues.zh: 其次，辛格維利爾（Thingvellir），意思是“集合平原”，是最初的阿爾辛的所在地，

cues.text: an annual gathering of early settlers.
cues.en: an annual gathering of early settlers.
cues.zh: 早期定居者的年度聚會

cues.text: This is where the nation of Iceland was born.
cues.en: This is where the nation of Iceland was born.
cues.zh: 這裡是冰島民族的誕生地。

cues.text: 1,000 years ago, chieftains from isolated farms all over the island traveled great distances
cues.en: 1,000 years ago, chieftains from isolated farms all over the island traveled great distances
cues.zh: 1000年前，島上各個偏僻農場的酋長長途跋涉

cues.text: to meet right here every summer and make important decisions.
cues.en: to meet right here every summer and make important decisions.
cues.zh: 每年夏天在這裡聚會並做出重要決定。

cues.text: In an age when almost no one could read or write, each meeting began by reciting the memorized highlights
cues.en: In an age when almost no one could read or write, each meeting began by reciting the memorized highlights
cues.zh: 在那個幾乎沒有人會讀或寫的時代，每次會議都是以背誦記憶的要點開始的

cues.text: from last year's gathering.
cues.en: from last year's gathering.
cues.zh: 從去年的聚會開始。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: History aside, Thingvellir is inviting for a nature walk.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: History aside, Thingvellir is inviting for a nature walk.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：拋開歷史不談，辛格維利爾國家公園非常適合在大自然中漫步。

cues.text: In this evocative spot, waterfalls tumble and the river flows as geology does its slow-motion dance.
cues.en: In this evocative spot, waterfalls tumble and the river flows as geology does its slow-motion dance.
cues.zh: 在這個令人回味的地方，瀑布傾瀉而下，河流如地質般慢動作舞蹈。

cues.text: ♪ Just up the road is a geological site
cues.en: ♪ Just up the road is a geological site
cues.zh: ♪ 沿著路走就是一個地質遺址

cues.text: actually called Geysir.
cues.en: actually called Geysir.
cues.zh: 實際上叫做蓋歇爾間歇泉（Geysir）。

cues.text: This geothermal field-- colorful and steamy with scalding water--is home to the original geyser,
cues.en: This geothermal field-- colorful and steamy with scalding water--is home to the original geyser,
cues.zh: 這片地熱田色彩繽紛，水氣騰騰，是原始間歇泉的所在地，

cues.text: which means "gusher" in Icelandic.
cues.en: which means "gusher" in Icelandic.
cues.zh: 在冰島語中意思是「噴湧」。

cues.text: The site is otherworldly as pools bubble and steam fills the air,
cues.en: The site is otherworldly as pools bubble and steam fills the air,
cues.zh: 這個地方超凡脫俗，水池冒泡，空氣中充滿蒸汽，

cues.text: all with a whiff of sulfur.
cues.en: all with a whiff of sulfur.
cues.zh: 都帶有一股硫磺的味道。

cues.text: But the big show is the central geyser.
cues.en: But the big show is the central geyser.
cues.zh: 但最大的亮點是中央間歇泉。

cues.text: ♪ Tourists line up, cameras poised with anticip--ation...
cues.en: ♪ Tourists line up, cameras poised with anticip--ation...
cues.zh: ♪ 遊客排隊，相機充滿期待…

cues.text: ready to capture the moment.
cues.en: ready to capture the moment.
cues.zh: 準備捕捉這一刻。

cues.text: They wait... and wait...and wait.
cues.en: They wait... and wait...and wait.
cues.zh: 他們等……等……等。

cues.text: Sometimes they wait so long, the weather actually improves.
cues.en: Sometimes they wait so long, the weather actually improves.
cues.zh: 有時他們等了很長時間，天氣實際上好轉了。

cues.text: And then, suddenly, with a gurgling belch the geyser explodes...rocketing skyward and thrilling the crowd.
cues.en: And then, suddenly, with a gurgling belch the geyser explodes...rocketing skyward and thrilling the crowd.
cues.zh: 然後，突然間，伴隨著咕嚕咕嚕的打嗝聲，間歇泉爆炸了……衝上天空，讓人群興奮不已。

cues.text: ♪ As you drive the Golden Circle,
cues.en: ♪ As you drive the Golden Circle,
cues.zh: ♪ 當您駕車遊覽黃金圈時，

cues.text: remember to slow down and enjoy the scenery.
cues.en: remember to slow down and enjoy the scenery.
cues.zh: 記得放慢腳步，欣賞風景。

cues.text: And it's not just about the famous natural sights.
cues.en: And it's not just about the famous natural sights.
cues.zh: 這不僅僅是著名的自然景觀。

cues.text: Along the way, you'll see slices of Iceland's unique agriculture.
cues.en: Along the way, you'll see slices of Iceland's unique agriculture.
cues.zh: 一路上，您將看到冰島獨特農業的片段。

cues.text: ♪ With its efficient greenhouses, even with the lack of good topsoil
cues.en: ♪ With its efficient greenhouses, even with the lack of good topsoil
cues.zh: ♪ 憑藉其高效的溫室，即使缺乏良好的表土

cues.text: and its difficult weather, Iceland grows plenty of tasty vegetables.
cues.en: and its difficult weather, Iceland grows plenty of tasty vegetables.
cues.zh: 儘管天氣惡劣，冰島卻種植了大量美味的蔬菜。

cues.text: The climate is harsh for conventional farming.
cues.en: The climate is harsh for conventional farming.
cues.zh: 對傳統農業來說，氣候十分惡劣。

cues.text: But its expertise in greenhouse technology and in putting geothermal energy to good use
cues.en: But its expertise in greenhouse technology and in putting geothermal energy to good use
cues.zh: 但其在溫室技術和充分利用地熱能方面的專業知識

cues.text: yields an abundant harvest.
cues.en: yields an abundant harvest.
cues.zh: 帶來豐收。

cues.text: ♪ For lunch, we're stopping at a working farm.
cues.en: ♪ For lunch, we're stopping at a working farm.
cues.zh: ♪ 我們在一個正在運作的農場停下來吃午餐。

cues.text: It's clear that frugal farmers here are tapping into the tourist boom.
cues.en: It's clear that frugal farmers here are tapping into the tourist boom.
cues.zh: 顯然，這裡節儉的農民正在利用旅遊業的繁榮。

cues.text: This family now serves hungry sightseers.
cues.en: This family now serves hungry sightseers.
cues.zh: 這個家庭現在為飢餓的遊客提供服務。

cues.text: The soup bar is a budget standby: it's all you can slurp, with fresh-baked bread
cues.en: The soup bar is a budget standby: it's all you can slurp, with fresh-baked bread
cues.zh: 湯吧是個經濟實惠的備用場所：您可以盡情暢飲，搭配新鮮出爐的麵包

cues.text: and a glass of water and a cup of coffee.
cues.en: and a glass of water and a cup of coffee.
cues.zh: 和一杯水和一杯咖啡。

cues.text: You can finish with a farm-fresh dessert with a special twist: the cows actually watch the diners
cues.en: You can finish with a farm-fresh dessert with a special twist: the cows actually watch the diners
cues.zh: 您可以享用帶有特殊風味的農場新鮮甜點作為結束：奶牛實際上會看著食客

cues.text: enjoying ice cream made from their very own milk.
cues.en: enjoying ice cream made from their very own milk.
cues.zh: 享受用自己的牛奶製成的冰淇淋。

cues.text: ♪ For generations, this family has raised horses.
cues.en: ♪ For generations, this family has raised horses.
cues.zh: ♪ 這個家族世代養馬。

cues.text: Horse lovers know that Iceland's local breed is special.
cues.en: Horse lovers know that Iceland's local breed is special.
cues.zh: 愛馬的人都知道冰島的本地品種很特別。

cues.text: Small and sturdy, these were first brought over by Vikings in the Settlement Age, 1,000 years ago,
cues.en: Small and sturdy, these were first brought over by Vikings in the Settlement Age, 1,000 years ago,
cues.zh: 這些小而堅固，是 1000 年前的定居時代維京人首次帶來的，

cues.text: chosen because they could fit inside the hold of a ship, yet they were strong enough to work hard once they arrived.
cues.en: chosen because they could fit inside the hold of a ship, yet they were strong enough to work hard once they arrived.
cues.zh: 之所以被選中，是因為他們可以裝進船艙，一旦到達，他們就足夠強壯，可以努力工作。

cues.text: Throughout the country, you'll see these wind-blown beauties.
cues.en: Throughout the country, you'll see these wind-blown beauties.
cues.zh: 在全國各地，您都會看到這些隨風飄揚的美景。

cues.text: A long-established ban on importing other breeds means that today's Icelandic horses are purebred and unique.
cues.en: A long-established ban on importing other breeds means that today's Icelandic horses are purebred and unique.
cues.zh: 長期禁止進口其他品種意味著今天的冰島馬是純種且獨特的。

cues.text: ♪ They also have a distinctive gait that thrills equestrians.
cues.en: ♪ They also have a distinctive gait that thrills equestrians.
cues.zh: ♪ 它們還有令馬術愛好者興奮不已的獨特步伐。

cues.text: The final stop on our Golden Circle loop is one of the most impressive waterfalls
cues.en: The final stop on our Golden Circle loop is one of the most impressive waterfalls
cues.zh: 黃金圈環線的最後一站是最令人印象深刻的瀑布之一

cues.text: in a country famed for waterfalls: Gullfoss--the Golden Falls.
cues.en: in a country famed for waterfalls: Gullfoss--the Golden Falls.
cues.zh: 在一個以瀑布聞名的國家：Gullfoss－黃金瀑布。

cues.text: The churning glacial river plummets into a narrow gorge.
cues.en: The churning glacial river plummets into a narrow gorge.
cues.zh: 翻騰的冰川河流入狹窄的峽谷。

cues.text: Up close, the cauldron comes with a deafening roar.
cues.en: Up close, the cauldron comes with a deafening roar.
cues.zh: 近距離一看，大鍋子發出震耳欲聾的轟鳴聲。

cues.text: And even from high above, visitors feel the spray, wonderstruck.
cues.en: And even from high above, visitors feel the spray, wonderstruck.
cues.zh: 即使在高空，遊客也能感受到水花，驚嘆不已。

cues.text: Gullfoss is just one of many waterfalls Iceland has to offer.
cues.en: Gullfoss is just one of many waterfalls Iceland has to offer.
cues.zh: 黃金瀑布只是冰島眾多瀑布之一。

cues.text: But if you only have time to see one, this is it.
cues.en: But if you only have time to see one, this is it.
cues.zh: 但如果你只有時間看一看，那就是這個了。

cues.text: It's rare anywhere on earth to find such a dramatic display
cues.en: It's rare anywhere on earth to find such a dramatic display
cues.zh: 在地球上任何地方都很難找到如此戲劇性的展示

cues.text: of water and gravity.
cues.en: of water and gravity.
cues.zh: 水和重力。

cues.text: ♪ Gullfoss is one of those places Iceland specializes in,
cues.en: ♪ Gullfoss is one of those places Iceland specializes in,
cues.zh: ♪ 黃金瀑布是冰島的特色景點之一，

cues.text: where you feel the raw power of nature.
cues.en: where you feel the raw power of nature.
cues.zh: 在那裡你感受到大自然的原始力量。

cues.text: It's the perfect climax to a Golden Circle day.
cues.en: It's the perfect climax to a Golden Circle day.
cues.zh: 這是黃金圈日的完美高潮。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: And the final leg of the Golden Circle takes us across a vast volcanic plateau.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: And the final leg of the Golden Circle takes us across a vast volcanic plateau.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：黃金圈的最後一段將帶我們穿越廣闊的火山高原。

cues.text: From this lonely lunar landscape, we're just 30 minutes from downtown Reykjavík,
cues.en: From this lonely lunar landscape, we're just 30 minutes from downtown Reykjavík,
cues.zh: 從這片孤獨的月球景觀中，我們距離雷克雅維克市中心僅 30 分鐘路程，

cues.text: and, as it happens, it's time for dinner.
cues.en: and, as it happens, it's time for dinner.
cues.zh: 碰巧，到了吃晚餐的時間了。

cues.text: Eating in Iceland is expensive.
cues.en: Eating in Iceland is expensive.
cues.zh: 在冰島吃飯很貴。

cues.text: Thankfully, you've got a range of options, from fish and chips to fine French cuisine.
cues.en: Thankfully, you've got a range of options, from fish and chips to fine French cuisine.
cues.zh: 值得慶幸的是，您有多種選擇，從炸魚薯條到精緻的法國美食。

cues.text: If you're willing to pay for it, you can eat really well.
cues.en: If you're willing to pay for it, you can eat really well.
cues.zh: 如果你願意付出代價，你就可以吃得很好。

cues.text: And tonight, we're enjoying a splurge.
cues.en: And tonight, we're enjoying a splurge.
cues.zh: 今晚，我們將盡情揮霍。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: This trendy restaurant features traditional local ingredients but with a modern twist.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: This trendy restaurant features traditional local ingredients but with a modern twist.
cues.zh: 瑞克（Rick），畫外音：這家時尚餐廳以傳統的當地食材為特色，但又融入了現代風味。

cues.text: You'll find the staples you'd expect, like lamb and fish.
cues.en: You'll find the staples you'd expect, like lamb and fish.
cues.zh: 您會找到您想要的主食，例如羊肉和魚。

cues.text: ♪ While the perpetual flames of the kitchen kick out
cues.en: ♪ While the perpetual flames of the kitchen kick out
cues.zh: ♪ 當廚房的永恆火焰熄滅時

cues.text: plenty of meat for carnivores, it always has a vegetarian option.
cues.en: plenty of meat for carnivores, it always has a vegetarian option.
cues.zh: 對於肉食動物來說有很多肉，它總是有素食選擇。

cues.text: I'm dining with my travel buddy and fellow guidebook author Cameron Hewitt,
cues.en: I'm dining with my travel buddy and fellow guidebook author Cameron Hewitt,
cues.zh: 我正在和我的旅行夥伴、旅遊指南作者卡梅倫·休伊特 (Cameron Hewitt) 一起用餐，

cues.text: and we're starting our meal with Arctic char and langoustine lava rocks, served on a lava rock.
cues.en: and we're starting our meal with Arctic char and langoustine lava rocks, served on a lava rock.
cues.zh: 我們的餐點是在熔岩上盛放北極紅點鮭和海螯蝦熔岩。

cues.text: Cameron: So, the inside is langoustine, which are kind of like little super-- super-sized shrimp.
cues.en: Cameron: So, the inside is langoustine, which are kind of like little super-- super-sized shrimp.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：所以，裡面是海螯蝦，有點像超大的小蝦。

cues.text: Rick: It's like it's tempura, but they...
cues.en: Rick: It's like it's tempura, but they...
cues.zh: 瑞克：就像天婦羅一樣，但是他們...

cues.text: Cameron: They made it look like lava rocks on lava rock.
cues.en: Cameron: They made it look like lava rocks on lava rock.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：他們讓它看起來像熔岩上的熔岩。

cues.text: Rick: Actually cooked in a lava flow.
cues.en: Rick: Actually cooked in a lava flow.
cues.zh: 瑞克：實際上是在熔岩流中煮熟的。

cues.text: Cameron: Yeah. Rick: That's good.
cues.en: Cameron: Yeah. Rick: That's good.
cues.zh: 卡梅倫：是的。瑞克：那很好。

cues.text: Cameron: Arctic char, which is kind of like--tastes like salmon, sort of pink fish.
cues.en: Cameron: Arctic char, which is kind of like--tastes like salmon, sort of pink fish.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：北極紅點鮭，味道有點像鮭魚，一種粉紅色的魚。

cues.text: Has mustard seed and dill on top.
cues.en: Has mustard seed and dill on top.
cues.zh: 上面有芥菜籽和蒔蘿。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: If this seems fancy, it is.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: If this seems fancy, it is.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：如果這看起來很奇特，那麼確實如此。

cues.text: Iceland, while expensive, is a place to invest in a memorable meal.
cues.en: Iceland, while expensive, is a place to invest in a memorable meal.
cues.zh: 冰島雖然價格昂貴，但卻是個值得投資難忘美食的地方。

cues.text: Rick: It's going to cost you a fair amount anyway.
cues.en: Rick: It's going to cost you a fair amount anyway.
cues.zh: 瑞克：無論如何，這都會花費你相當多的錢。

cues.text: So, you go just a little bit more, you can have this.
cues.en: So, you go just a little bit more, you can have this.
cues.zh: 所以，你再多走一點，你就能得到這個。

cues.text: Cameron: Yeah, that's what I think.
cues.en: Cameron: Yeah, that's what I think.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：是的，我就是這麼想的。

cues.text: You save up and eat groceries for a few days and then splurge for a meal like this.
cues.en: You save up and eat groceries for a few days and then splurge for a meal like this.
cues.zh: 你存錢並吃幾天雜貨，然後像這樣揮霍一頓飯。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: For our main course, we're having some of those staples.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: For our main course, we're having some of those staples.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：對於我們的主菜，我們有一些主食。

cues.text: Cameron's having the salted cod and I'm going for the lamb chops,
cues.en: Cameron's having the salted cod and I'm going for the lamb chops,
cues.zh: 卡梅倫要吃鹹鱈魚，我要吃羊排，

cues.text: but with sauces and presentation the Vikings wouldn't recognize.
cues.en: but with sauces and presentation the Vikings wouldn't recognize.
cues.zh: 但維京人無法辨識醬汁和擺盤。

cues.text: Rick: I think they know many ways to do cod here, I would imagine.
cues.en: Rick: I think they know many ways to do cod here, I would imagine.
cues.zh: 瑞克：我想他們知道這裡有很多做鱈魚的方法。

cues.text: Cameron: Yeah, it's very good.
cues.en: Cameron: Yeah, it's very good.
cues.zh: 卡梅倫：是的，非常好。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: To drink, I prefer something domestic-- and this island definitely doesn't produce any wine.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: To drink, I prefer something domestic-- and this island definitely doesn't produce any wine.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：說到喝酒，我比較喜歡國產的－－而這個島絕對不生產任何葡萄酒。

cues.text: Instead, it's a local microbrew.
cues.en: Instead, it's a local microbrew.
cues.zh: 相反，它是當地的微釀啤酒。

cues.text: Finally, it's profiteroles for dessert.
cues.en: Finally, it's profiteroles for dessert.
cues.zh: 最後是甜點巧克力。

cues.text: With this, that fermented shark is a distant memory,
cues.en: With this, that fermented shark is a distant memory,
cues.zh: 從此，那條發酵鯊魚就變成遙遠的記憶了，

cues.text: and that is certainly worth paying a premium for.
cues.en: and that is certainly worth paying a premium for.
cues.zh: 這當然值得付出溢價。

cues.text: From here in downtown Reykjavík, we'll drive 800 miles all the way around Iceland's Ring Road.
cues.en: From here in downtown Reykjavík, we'll drive 800 miles all the way around Iceland's Ring Road.
cues.zh: 從雷克雅未克市中心出發，我們將沿著冰島環路行駛 800 英里。

cues.text: Which highway? Highway 1, of course.
cues.en: Which highway? Highway 1, of course.
cues.zh: 哪條高速公路？當然是1號公路。

cues.text: You can't get lost.
cues.en: You can't get lost.
cues.zh: 你不能迷路。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: On the first leg is Iceland's South Coast.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: On the first leg is Iceland's South Coast.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：第一站是冰島南岸。

cues.text: Just two hours from Reykjavík and we're already deep in the thrills, chalking up the experiences
cues.en: Just two hours from Reykjavík and we're already deep in the thrills, chalking up the experiences
cues.zh: 距離雷克雅未克僅兩小時路程，我們已經沉浸在激動之中，記錄下這些經歷

cues.text: people visiting here dream of.
cues.en: people visiting here dream of.
cues.zh: 來到這裡的人們的夢想。

cues.text: Driving the entire Ring Road takes about 30 hours non-stop.
cues.en: Driving the entire Ring Road takes about 30 hours non-stop.
cues.zh: 不間斷行駛整個環路大約需要30小時。

cues.text: To do it justice, you need at least 5 or 6 days.
cues.en: To do it justice, you need at least 5 or 6 days.
cues.zh: 要做到公正，您至少需要 5 或 6 天。

cues.text: You can go in either direction-- we're going counter-clockwise-- and it's summertime, so, it stays light really late.
cues.en: You can go in either direction-- we're going counter-clockwise-- and it's summertime, so, it stays light really late.
cues.zh: 你可以朝任何一個方向走——我們是逆時針方向——而且現在是夏季，所以，天氣很晚才亮。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Seljalandsfoss--one of Iceland's most accessible waterfalls-- is a favorite stop.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Seljalandsfoss--one of Iceland's most accessible waterfalls-- is a favorite stop.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：塞裡雅蘭瀑布－冰島最容易到達的瀑布之一－是最受歡迎的一站。

cues.text: The water tumbles more than 200 feet from cliffs high above, like a bridal veil.
cues.en: The water tumbles more than 200 feet from cliffs high above, like a bridal veil.
cues.zh: 水從高高的懸崖上滾落 200 多英尺，就像新娘的頭紗。

cues.text: On sunny days, the scene is like a party as everybody is suddenly waterfall crazy and connoisseurs of rainbows.
cues.en: On sunny days, the scene is like a party as everybody is suddenly waterfall crazy and connoisseurs of rainbows.
cues.zh: 在陽光明媚的日子裡，這裡就像一場派對，每個人都突然為瀑布瘋狂，成為彩虹鑑賞家。

cues.text: ♪ Late in the day, with the setting sun,
cues.en: ♪ Late in the day, with the setting sun,
cues.zh: ♪ 傍晚時分，夕陽西下，

cues.text: everyone's a photographer.
cues.en: everyone's a photographer.
cues.zh: 每個人都是攝影師。

cues.text: A slippery trail leads up behind the cascading water and back here, the energy is palpable.
cues.en: A slippery trail leads up behind the cascading water and back here, the energy is palpable.
cues.zh: 一條濕滑的小路通往瀑布後面，再回到這裡，能量是顯而易見的。

cues.text: And rain parkas get a good workout.
cues.en: And rain parkas get a good workout.
cues.zh: 雨天派克大衣可以很好地鍛鍊身體。

cues.text: Here in Iceland, we experience both the power of nature and the beauty of nature.
cues.en: Here in Iceland, we experience both the power of nature and the beauty of nature.
cues.zh: 在冰島，我們體驗了大自然的力量和自然的美麗。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: This country is expert at monetizing its stunning nature--making the great outdoors accessible.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: This country is expert at monetizing its stunning nature--making the great outdoors accessible.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：這個國家擅長將其令人驚嘆的自然風光貨幣化，讓人們可以接觸到精彩的戶外活動。

cues.text: Each morning, rugged vehicles load up with tourists and head for the backcountry.
cues.en: Each morning, rugged vehicles load up with tourists and head for the backcountry.
cues.zh: 每天早上，崎嶇不平的車輛滿載著遊客前往偏遠地區。

cues.text: We've hired one of these enormous trucks with a driver, eager for a thrilling experience.
cues.en: We've hired one of these enormous trucks with a driver, eager for a thrilling experience.
cues.zh: 我們租了一輛有司機的巨型卡車，渴望獲得驚險的體驗。

cues.text: We're heading up a remote and rocky valley called Thorsmork.
cues.en: We're heading up a remote and rocky valley called Thorsmork.
cues.zh: 我們正前往一個偏遠、多岩石的山谷，名叫索斯莫克。

cues.text: Even in this land of superlatives, Thorsmork is one-of-a-kind.
cues.en: Even in this land of superlatives, Thorsmork is one-of-a-kind.
cues.zh: 即使在這片最高階的土地上，索斯莫克也是獨一無二的。

cues.text: Venturing far beyond where normal cars can tread, it's a land of super-vehicles.
cues.en: Venturing far beyond where normal cars can tread, it's a land of super-vehicles.
cues.zh: 這裡的冒險遠遠超出了普通汽車的極限，這是一片超級汽車的土地。

cues.text: But it's still accessible.
cues.en: But it's still accessible.
cues.zh: 但它仍然可以訪問。

cues.text: There's even a public bus service up this remote valley.
cues.en: There's even a public bus service up this remote valley.
cues.zh: 這個偏遠的山谷甚至還有公共巴士服務。

cues.text: All must have tires that deflate with the push of a button for extra traction.
cues.en: All must have tires that deflate with the push of a button for extra traction.
cues.zh: 所有輪胎都必須具有透過按下按鈕即可放氣的輪胎，以提供額外的牽引力。

cues.text: "Super-jeeps" and buses alike, equipped with these monster tires,
cues.en: "Super-jeeps" and buses alike, equipped with these monster tires,
cues.zh: 「超級吉普車」和巴士都配備了這些怪物輪胎，

cues.text: churn through rivers of glacial melt, giving all on board a tale to tell.
cues.en: churn through rivers of glacial melt, giving all on board a tale to tell.
cues.zh: 在冰川融化的河流中翻騰，為船上的所有人講述一個故事。

cues.text: ♪ People come to hike.
cues.en: ♪ People come to hike.
cues.zh: ♪ 人們來徒步旅行。

cues.text: Remote lodges provide simple bases.
cues.en: Remote lodges provide simple bases.
cues.zh: 偏遠的小屋提供簡單的基地。

cues.text: Up here, nature is a great equalizer as everyone is psyching up...
cues.en: Up here, nature is a great equalizer as everyone is psyching up...
cues.zh: 在這裡，大自然是一個偉大的均衡器，因為每個人都興奮不已...

cues.text: prepping to create that lifetime memory.
cues.en: prepping to create that lifetime memory.
cues.zh: 準備創造終生記憶。

cues.text: And hikers appreciate the portable footbridges.
cues.en: And hikers appreciate the portable footbridges.
cues.zh: 徒步旅行者喜歡行動式人行橋。

cues.text: They come with wheels to be repositioned each season depending on where the river flows.
cues.en: They come with wheels to be repositioned each season depending on where the river flows.
cues.zh: 它們的輪子會根據河流的流向在每個季節重新定位。

cues.text: Charging deeper and deeper into the valley, I keep thinking the off-road prowess of our vehicle
cues.en: Charging deeper and deeper into the valley, I keep thinking the off-road prowess of our vehicle
cues.zh: 越往山谷深處衝去，我不斷地思考著我們車輛的越野能力

cues.text: would make for a great TV ad.
cues.en: would make for a great TV ad.
cues.zh: 會成為一個很棒的電視廣告。

cues.text: ♪ Finally, after parking our super-jeep, we actually
cues.en: ♪ Finally, after parking our super-jeep, we actually
cues.zh: ♪ 最後，停好我們的超級吉普車後，我們實際上

cues.text: work up a sweat with a short hike.
cues.en: work up a sweat with a short hike.
cues.zh: 短途徒步出一身汗。

cues.text: Feeling small in this primeval setting, we're humbled at the majesty of what surrounds us.
cues.en: Feeling small in this primeval setting, we're humbled at the majesty of what surrounds us.
cues.zh: 在這原始的環境中，我們感覺到自己的渺小，同時也對周遭事物的威嚴感到謙卑。

cues.text: ♪ And glaciers, reaching down from the mountains,
cues.en: ♪ And glaciers, reaching down from the mountains,
cues.zh: ♪ 還有從山上延伸下來的冰川，

cues.text: remind us of Iceland's snowcapped rooftop.
cues.en: remind us of Iceland's snowcapped rooftop.
cues.zh: 讓我們想起冰島白雪皚皚的屋頂。

cues.text: The black on the ice is ash. It's from volcanic eruptions.
cues.en: The black on the ice is ash. It's from volcanic eruptions.
cues.zh: 冰上的黑色是灰燼。它來自火山爆發。

cues.text: Could be fresh, could be very old.
cues.en: Could be fresh, could be very old.
cues.zh: 可能是新鮮的，也可能是很舊的。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Nature is dynamic here.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Nature is dynamic here.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：這裡的大自然充滿活力。

cues.text: It's unpredictable. It changes without asking.
cues.en: It's unpredictable. It changes without asking.
cues.zh: 這是不可預測的。它不問而變。

cues.text: in warm water tinted with natural minerals.

cues.zh: 胡薩維克鯨魚博物館展示了從島嶼周圍衝上岸的鯨魚骨頭。

cues.text: ♪ The lovingly displayed skeletons teach visitors about these magnificent mammals.
cues.en: ♪ The lovingly displayed skeletons teach visitors about these magnificent mammals.
cues.zh: ♪ 精心展示的骨骼向遊客介紹這些宏偉的哺乳動物。

cues.en: ♪ The star of the show-- an 80-foot-long blue whale,
cues.zh: ♪ 表演明星－一隻 80 英尺長的藍鯨，

cues.text: with a rib cage as big as a truck.
cues.en: with a rib cage as big as a truck.
cues.zh: 胸腔有卡車那麼大。

cues.en: For a chance to watch living whales, out at the harbor, visitors choose between classic fishing boats

cues.en: or--for a little more adventure-- high-speed inflatables.
cues.zh: 或者──如果想多一點冒險──高速充氣艇。

cues.zh: 遊客爬上船，為有機會與溫柔的巨人近距離接觸而興奮不已。

cues.zh: 繼續穿過冰島北部，沿海公路蜿蜒環繞巨魔半島，

cues.text: with sweeping vistas toward the Arctic Circle.
cues.en: with sweeping vistas toward the Arctic Circle.
cues.zh: 欣賞北極圈一覽無遺的景色。

cues.text: At the tip of the Troll Peninsula sits the historic fishing town of Siglufjordur.
cues.en: At the tip of the Troll Peninsula sits the historic fishing town of Siglufjordur.
cues.zh: 巨魔半島的頂端坐落著歷史悠久的漁鎮錫格魯菲厄澤 (Siglufjordur)。

cues.text: The mountains at the mouth of the fjord protect the little harbor.
cues.en: The mountains at the mouth of the fjord protect the little harbor.
cues.zh: 峽灣口的山脈保護著這個小港口。

cues.text: And behind it is an endearing museum that tells the story of how, around 1900,
cues.en: And behind it is an endearing museum that tells the story of how, around 1900,
cues.zh: 它後面是一座可愛的博物館，講述了 1900 年左右的故事，

cues.text: this became a boom town for herring.
cues.en: this became a boom town for herring.
cues.zh: 這裡成為了鯡魚的繁榮城鎮。

cues.text: Visitors learn how these tough, little boats caught mountains of herring--
cues.en: Visitors learn how these tough, little boats caught mountains of herring--
cues.zh: 遊客可以瞭解這些堅韌的小船如何捕獲堆積如山的鯡魚——

cues.text: a nutritious and highly prized food.
cues.en: a nutritious and highly prized food.
cues.zh: 一種營養豐富且珍貴的食物。

cues.text: This herring harvest powered Iceland's fledgling economy through the first half of the 20th century.
cues.en: This herring harvest powered Iceland's fledgling economy through the first half of the 20th century.
cues.zh: 鯡魚的收穫在 20 世紀上半葉為冰島剛起步的經濟提供了動力。

cues.text: Cameron's learning more about the story from local guide Edda.
cues.en: Cameron's learning more about the story from local guide Edda.
cues.zh: 卡梅倫從當地導遊埃達那裡瞭解了更多關於這個故事的資訊。

cues.text: Cameron: Tell me, why is it in this town, why herring?
cues.en: Cameron: Tell me, why is it in this town, why herring?
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：告訴我，為什麼是在這個小鎮，為什麼是鯡魚？

cues.text: What's special about herring to this town?
cues.en: What's special about herring to this town?
cues.zh: 這個小鎮的鯡魚有什麼特別之處？

cues.text: Edda: So, the herring industry was, for the longest time, one of the biggest industries in the country,
cues.en: Edda: So, the herring industry was, for the longest time, one of the biggest industries in the country,
cues.zh: 埃達：所以，鯡魚業在很長一段時間內是全國最大的產業之一，

cues.text: for the most part of the 20th century.
cues.en: for the most part of the 20th century.
cues.zh: 20世紀的大部分時間。

cues.text: And for the longest time, this town had the biggest herring port in Iceland.
cues.en: And for the longest time, this town had the biggest herring port in Iceland.
cues.zh: 在很長一段時間裡，這個小鎮擁有冰島最大的鯡魚港口。

cues.text: And we often refer to this as the capital of the herring.
cues.en: And we often refer to this as the capital of the herring.
cues.zh: 我們常稱這裡為鯡魚之都。

cues.text: So, we are located in front of a salting station, and from 1907 until 1968, herring was salted here.
cues.en: So, we are located in front of a salting station, and from 1907 until 1968, herring was salted here.
cues.zh: 所以，我們位於一個鹽醃站前，從 1907 年到 1968 年，鯡魚都是在這裡醃製的。

cues.text: We had the women, the herring girls, salting and packing the herring into the barrels.
cues.en: We had the women, the herring girls, salting and packing the herring into the barrels.
cues.zh: 我們讓婦女們，即鯡魚女孩，將鯡魚醃製並裝入桶中。

cues.text: Cameron: And so, this, this table here is exactly where that happened.
cues.en: Cameron: And so, this, this table here is exactly where that happened.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：所以，這張桌子就是那件事發生的地方。

cues.text: Edda: Yeah. So, this is what we call the herring box.
cues.en: Edda: Yeah. So, this is what we call the herring box.
cues.zh: 艾達：是的。所以，這就是我們所說的鯡魚盒。

cues.text: And the fishermen coming into the fjord would start by unloading the herring into those boxes,
cues.en: And the fishermen coming into the fjord would start by unloading the herring into those boxes,
cues.zh: 進入峽灣的漁民首先將鯡魚卸下到這些盒子裡，

cues.text: and then they would call out the herring girls for work, and they would take one herring at a time,
cues.en: and then they would call out the herring girls for work, and they would take one herring at a time,
cues.zh: 然後他們會叫來捕鯡魚的女孩去幹活，一次只捕一條鯡魚，

cues.text: cutting the head off and pulling the guts out.
cues.en: cutting the head off and pulling the guts out.
cues.zh: 把頭砍下來，把內臟拉出來。

cues.text: And then they would place the herring in here.
cues.en: And then they would place the herring in here.
cues.zh: 然後他們會把鯡魚放在這裡。

cues.text: They would do this until they had almost filled this container.
cues.en: They would do this until they had almost filled this container.
cues.zh: 他們會這樣做，直到幾乎填滿這個容器。

cues.text: Then, in here, they would mix it with the salt and then finally stack it into the barrels.
cues.en: Then, in here, they would mix it with the salt and then finally stack it into the barrels.
cues.zh: 然後，在這裡，他們將其與鹽混合，最後堆入桶中。

cues.text: So, this is where the herring girls would live.
cues.en: So, this is where the herring girls would live.
cues.zh: 所以，這就是鯡魚女孩們居住的地方。

cues.text: The women that would come from all the places in Iceland just to work here at this particular salting station.
cues.en: The women that would come from all the places in Iceland just to work here at this particular salting station.
cues.zh: 來自冰島各地的婦女只是為了在這個特殊的鹽醃站工作。

cues.text: This would be an example of their bedrooms.
cues.en: This would be an example of their bedrooms.
cues.zh: 這是他們臥室的一個例子。

cues.text: Cameron: OK. How many herring girls would live in a room about this size?
cues.en: Cameron: OK. How many herring girls would live in a room about this size?
cues.zh: 卡梅倫：好的。這麼大的房間裡能住多少鯡魚女孩？

cues.text: Edda: So, there could be up to 50 women living in all this, the whole building.
cues.en: Edda: So, there could be up to 50 women living in all this, the whole building.
cues.zh: Edda：所以，整棟大樓裡可能住著多達 50 名女性。

cues.text: But at the busiest years, they would have to share the beds, two to a bed.
cues.en: But at the busiest years, they would have to share the beds, two to a bed.
cues.zh: 但最忙的時候，他們得共用一張床，兩人一張床。

cues.text: So, there could be up to 12 women living in a room this size.
cues.en: So, there could be up to 12 women living in a room this size.
cues.zh: 因此，這麼大的房間裡最多可以住 12 位女性。

cues.text: Cameron: Tell me about their working hours.
cues.en: Cameron: Tell me about their working hours.
cues.zh: 卡麥隆：告訴我他們的工作時間。

cues.text: Edda: When there was herring to be salted, they need to be outside working.
cues.en: Edda: When there was herring to be salted, they need to be outside working.
cues.zh: 埃達：當有鯡魚需要醃製時，他們需要在外面工作。

cues.text: And so, that meant that they could be working very long shifts.
cues.en: And so, that meant that they could be working very long shifts.
cues.zh: 因此，這意味著他們可能要輪班很長時間。

cues.text: So, it could be 20-hour shifts, and one herring girl we interviewed,
cues.en: So, it could be 20-hour shifts, and one herring girl we interviewed,
cues.zh: 所以，可能是 20 小時輪班，我們採訪了一位捕鯡魚的女孩，

cues.text: she said that her longer shift by the herring box was 34 hours straight.
cues.en: she said that her longer shift by the herring box was 34 hours straight.
cues.zh: 她說，她在鯡魚箱旁的輪班時間較長，連續 34 小時工作。

cues.en: Rick, voice-over: It's inspiring to see the thoughtful ways Iceland preserves and celebrates its unique heritage.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：看到冰島以深思熟慮的方式儲存和慶祝其獨特的遺產，真是令人鼓舞。

cues.zh: 完成環路並離開海岸後，道路轉向南邊。

cues.zh: 裡面有一條土質走廊連線幾個房間。

cues.text: Food was stored in wooden barrels.
cues.en: Food was stored in wooden barrels.
cues.zh: 食物儲存在木桶中。

cues.text: In the kitchen, meals were cooked over a sheep dung fire.
cues.en: In the kitchen, meals were cooked over a sheep dung fire.
cues.zh: 廚房裡，飯菜是用羊糞火煮飯的。

cues.text: The farmer's family had a spacious bedroom all to themselves.
cues.en: The farmer's family had a spacious bedroom all to themselves.
cues.zh: 農民一家有一間寬敞的臥室。

cues.text: But the farmhands bunked in a communal living room.
cues.en: But the farmhands bunked in a communal living room.

cues.zh: 從事精細紡紗工作的女人們把床鋪放在靠近窗戶的地方，以獲得更好的光線。
